Subject: Vendor evidence request: CAIQ + SOC 2 + subprocessors

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — FinSecure's procurement & security teams are kicking off the vendor risk assessment for Redwood ahead of our POC. Can you please provide the following by COB next week if possible:  

- Completed CAIQ (latest version) or your standard SIG-lite template
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (or a redacted copy if needed)
- Full list of subprocessors (name, purpose, region of processing)
- Pen test summary and date of last engagement
- Network / architecture diagram (redacted is fine)

Also: any information on how telemetry/diagnostic data is handled (retention, export controls) and whether any subprocessors process FinSecure data outside the US.

I've attached our intake form (FinSecure_Audit_Request_2026-03.pdf) — please upload evidence to the shared Drive link on the form or reply with attachments. If full SOC2 distribution requires an NDA, let me know and we can escalate.

Regards,
Elena Torres

Jonas / team — I'm on it. Quick notes and what I'll be sharing:

1) SOC 2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II 2024 report for external review. Full report available under standard NDA process. Redactions will remove customer-specific IPs, internal ticket references (SR-###), and any explicit client identifiers.

2) Subprocessor list: attached CSV (subprocessors_2026-02.csv) contains columns: vendor_name, service, data_purpose, data_location_region, last_contract_review. We'll mark any vendors that process payment or personal identifiers in the CSV.

3) Pen test: attach pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (executive summary + remediation status). Full technical report is restricted.

4) Network diagram: I'll attach a redacted PNG (network_diagram_redacted.png). This shows the high-level service boundary and where customer workloads are isolated.

5) CAIQ/SIG: Priyom — I pulled the SIG-lite answers we used for MavenBank last quarter; I'm happy to review. For a few CAIQ items related to cryptographic key management and HSM usage, we'll respond with our KMS/HSM partners and indicate keys are customer-scoped for Private deployments.

6) Telemetry: short answer for FinSecure — we collect anonymized service metrics for performance and billing. PII is not captured in telemetry export by default. We'll include the relevant retention policy and export controls snippet.

Timing: I expect the package ready to upload to a shared Drive folder by EOD 2026-03-04. Please let me know if you need any additional redactions for legal/release control.

Attachments: SOC2_type2_2024_redacted.pdf, subprocessors_2026-02.csv, network_diagram_redacted.png, pen_test_summary_2025.pdf

Monica Patel
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the request — attached is a compiled package we prepared per your intake. Files included below are redacted where appropriate:

- SOC2_type2_2024_redacted.pdf (redactions: customer-specific IPs / ticket IDs; full report available under NDA)
- subprocessors_2026-02.csv (vendor, service, region of processing)
- pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (executive summary + remediation status)
- network_diagram_redacted.png (high-level architecture)
- CAIQ_SIG-lite-responses.docx (brief answers to CAIQ/SIG questions) [uploaded to Drive]

I've uploaded the package to the shared Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEFgHIjkl-Redwood-FinSecure-Share. If you need the SOC2 under an NDA, we can send a DocuSign request for a mutual NDA / DPA — I can generate that today.

A few clarifications based on your telemetry/third-country question:
- Telemetry: anonymized service metrics (latency, error rates, aggregate usage). No customer PII is included in those exports by default.
- Subprocessors: any vendor listed as processing outside the US is flagged in the CSV. The majority of our hosted telemetry processing is in US regions; Dedicated and Private deployments keep telemetry in-customer-region when requested.

Next step: would you prefer a 30-min technical walkthrough with Monica and Priyom later this week to go over the package? I'm available Thursday 9–11am PT or Friday 1–3pm PT.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber

Jonas — received, and thank you for the quick turnaround. I reviewed the package and have one clarifying question before we proceed to procurement: in subprocessors_2026-02.csv you list 'TelemetryOps Inc.' as providing observability tooling. Can you confirm the following for that vendor:  

1) Which data elements are sent to TelemetryOps (logs, metrics, traces)?
2) Whether any logs include customer identifiers (user IDs, email addresses) by default, or whether you mask those before forwarding.
3) The region where TelemetryOps processes Redwood telemetry for our account (US / EU / APAC) — FinSecure must ensure no export to non-approved jurisdictions.

Also: procurement will want the DocuSign DPA/NDA link when ready. If you can provide answers to the TelemetryOps questions and the DocuSign link today, we can move to the procurement review.

I'll hold scheduling the walkthrough until we confirm the TelemetryOps details.
